# SportsVentureX full site knowledge

## Identity and purpose

SportsVentureX (SVX) is a buyer-focused product development, manufacturing, and sourcing partner. SVX supports established brands, growing labels, retailers, supermarkets, clubs, schools, institutions, distributors, and specialist organisations. Current website programmes cover socks, footballs, bags, and apparel.

## Solutions

### Define
Clarify the category, customer, target price, quantity, destination market, specification, and launch date.

### Develop
Select materials, design, construction, technical details, sampling routes, and cost options.

### Validate
Review fit, performance, testing, compliance, packaging, and approval requirements.

### Produce
Place production with suitable factories, track the critical path, perform inline checks, and manage issues.

### Deliver
Coordinate final inspection, documentation, logistics, and repeat-order learning.

## Process

1. Define the category, customer, commercial target, and timeline.
2. Develop materials, design, construction, technical packs, samples, and costs.
3. Validate fit, performance, testing, compliance, packaging, and approvals.
4. Produce with factory placement, tracking, inline checks, and issue management.
5. Deliver with final inspection, documents, logistics coordination, and repeat-order learning.

## Quality focus

The quality focus includes material selection, sample refinement, brand consistency, production checks, and packaging readiness. The team focuses on feel, durability, finishing, and the confidence a product gives a brand.

## Product range

### Footballs
Eight development directions cover match, training, promotional, indoor, mini, beach, futsal, and specialist programmes. Construction options include thermo-bonded, hybrid, and hand-stitched builds. Final claims, testing, quantities, and commercial terms depend on the approved specification.

### Socks
Twenty-two website categories cover organic cotton, technical, dress, sports, performance, health, team, work, women’s, outdoor, travel, comfort, gym, running, recycled-yarn, thermal, family, school, hiking, and compression directions. Yarn, construction, cushioning, sizing, colour, branding, and packaging can be customised.

### Bags
Thirteen website categories cover backpacks, duffles, travel, team, school, technical, and other carry solutions. Materials, compartments, padding, hardware, trims, colours, graphics, and packaging can be specified for a buyer brief.

### Apparel
Thirteen website categories cover performance T-shirts, sweatshirts, football kits, hoodies, joggers, towels, robes, polo shirts, work trousers, workwear, technical jackets, base layers, and leggings. Fit, fabric, trims, colours, graphics, branding, and packaging can be developed around the brief.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can SportsVentureX support custom branding?
Yes. Custom branding is a core capability across product colourways, logos, labels, packaging, and finishing details.

### Which products are included?
The active website focuses on socks, footballs, bags, and apparel.

### Is the contact form connected?
Yes. Send an enquiry with product details and the SportsVentureX team will receive it directly.

### What are the prices, minimum order quantities, and lead times?
The public site does not publish fixed pricing, minimum order quantities, or lead times. These depend on product, construction, materials, branding, packaging, quantity, destination, compliance needs, and timing. Send a project brief for a tailored response.

## Contact

Use the project brief form for product details, brand requirements, target quantity, destination market, timing, and other questions, or email sales@sportsventurex.com. Exact commercial information is confirmed directly by the SVX team.
